items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I met this man and he knew about Mr. Coleman Hawkins

ctx.x: He's got a big trio down there... He's got a group that sounds just marvelous.

He hangs out with Pablo Casals and he still do the things, you see. But this is a man that's on his third life. We knew, we found out that later on in life that I met this man and he knew about Mr. Coleman Hawkins - but Garvan Bushell was the first one to bring Coleman Hawkins out into the world.
